title: The Arithmetic of Power
blurb: Every power that mattered was built by a small circle of capable people and a state ambitious enough to use them. The difference now is that those people choose where to go.

title: The Ninety-Fifth Percentile
blurb: In almost every field, the best are paid absurdly more than the very good. The gap is real, it is mostly explainable, and it is still a terrible way to measure a life.
